```text
backdown edge [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

## backdown edge add {#add}

Add a relationship edge: SRC REL DST, each node as type:key.

```text
backdown edge add [OPTIONS] <SRC> <REL> <DST>
```

### Arguments

`<SRC>`
: &nbsp;

`<REL>`
: &nbsp;

`<DST>`
: &nbsp;

### Options

`--data <DATA>`
: &nbsp;

## backdown edge from {#from}

Edges out of a node.

```text
backdown edge from [OPTIONS] <SRC>
```

### Arguments

`<SRC>`
: &nbsp;

### Options

`--json`
: Print it as JSON, for scripts.

## backdown edge to {#to}

Edges into a node.

```text
backdown edge to [OPTIONS] <DST>
```

### Arguments

`<DST>`
: &nbsp;

### Options

`--json`
: Print it as JSON, for scripts.

All of them also take the [global options](/docs/cli/#global-options) `--db` and `--local`.
